title: Paul McCartney live: Tokyo Dome, Tokyo | 1993
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan, on 14 November 1993.

It was the 66th night of the New World Tour, which lasted for 77 dates across 19 countries between February and December 1993, and the second of three nights in Tokyo.

McCartney’s band was Linda McCartney on vocals, keyboards, and percussion; Hamish Stuart on guitar, bass guitar, and vocals; Robbie McIntosh on guitar and vocals; Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens on keyboards and vocals; and Blair Cunningham on drums and percussion.

McCartney had previously performed at the Tokyo Dome on 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, and 13 March 1990. He returned there on 11, 13, and 14 November 2002; 18, 19, and 21 November 2013; 23, 25, and 27 April 2015; 27, 29, and 30 April 2017; and 31 October and 1 November 2018.
